changes: Added Śrīdatta as author (role 'author'). 'śrīdattapaddhatau' means 'in Śrīdatta's paddhati'; this is the Maithila Śrīdatta Upādhyāya, author of the Ekāgni(dāna)paddhati. So the name is an authorship attribution, not merely a word inside a title.
Everything else confirmed: there is no scribe, date, place or purpose.

notes: The colophon has only completion formulas for a section and for the whole text (puṣpikā). There is no scribal colophon, so nobody involved in making this copy is named. The author's name appears in two forms: 'śrīśrīdatta-' (honorific śrī + Śrīdatta) at fol. 115r9, and 'śrīpadatta-' at fol. 115r5–6, which is probably a miscopy of the same name. He is identified as the Maithila Śrīdatta Upādhyāya (c. 13th–14th century). 'Upādhyāya' is not written in the colophon, so it is not entered under titles.
